name: Test While Edge Cases
comment: Synthetic grammar for testing CheckWhileConditions branches (capture processing, End > linePos advancement, WhileStack population) and ScanNext WhileHasBackReferences path. Contains two begin/while rules: one with fixed while captures, one with back-reference in the while pattern.

while-block.comment: Block continuation rule with while captures. The while pattern ^(\s*)(>>) matches continuation lines starting with >>. WhileCaptures produce named scopes for the whitespace and marker, exercising HandleCaptures inside CheckWhileConditions. The match End > linePos triggers the linePos advancement branch (lines 528-532).
while-block.name: meta.block.continuation.test

while-backref.comment: Begin/while rule where the while pattern contains a back-reference (\1). This sets WhileHasBackReferences = true, exercising ScanNext line 203-207 (WithEndRule + GetWhileWithResolvedBackReferences). On begin, the delimiter word is captured in group 1. On continuation lines, the resolved while pattern checks for that same word.
while-backref.name: meta.while.backref.test
